findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R2 maps the requirement to milestones M1 and M2, but the plan’s concrete implementation of static-site emission (full HTML/CSS/JS assets) is scheduled in M4 (DL24). M1 explicitly describes only a skeleton emit plugin that writes placeholder output, which is insufficient to satisfy R2.

evidence.note: Sample check claims R2 is covered by milestones M1 and M2.
M1 emit deliverable is explicitly placeholder output, not full static site emission.
evidence.quote: "Skeleton Emit Plugin (C17) that writes placeholder output"

evidence.note: M4 includes the deliverable that actually fulfills static output emission for the site.
evidence.quote: "Emit Plugin (C17) fully writing HTML pages and static assets to output directory (R2)."

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R3 maps the requirement to milestones M1 and M2, but the plan schedules CommonMark rendering and actual HTML page generation in M4 (Markdown Render Plugin + Theme/Template + Emit). M1–M2 cover ingestion and metadata/tag extraction, not HTML rendering for each Markdown file.

evidence.note: Sample check claims R3 is covered by milestones M1 and M2.
R3 explicitly requires CommonMark parsing and generating an HTML page per input Markdown file.
evidence.quote: "parse each discovered Markdown file using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax and generate a corresponding HTML page"

evidence.note: CommonMark-compliant Markdown-to-HTML conversion is delivered in M4.
evidence.quote: "Markdown Render Plugin (C14) converting Markdown to HTML with CommonMark compliance"

evidence.note: Final per-note page rendering is delivered in M4.
Emission of the rendered HTML pages to output is delivered in M4.
evidence.quote: "fully writing HTML pages and static assets to output directory"

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R3 cites AT3 as the acceptance test, but AT3 validates page-count and exclusion behavior; it does not validate the “CommonMark-compliant syntax” part of R3. This makes the sample check semantically incomplete for the stated requirement text.

evidence.note: Sample check lists only AT3 for R3.
R3 includes a CommonMark compliance requirement in addition to page generation.
AT3 checks mapping/count of generated pages and exclusions, not syntax compliance.
evidence.quote: "Count generated HTML note pages and verify a one-to-one mapping for non-excluded files."
